business.description: The company could not undertake any commercial activities during the year. Promoters have concrete plans to activate business initiatives.

outlook.statement: Your Board therefore is optimistic of activating the business initiatives before long.

Your Company has taken several steps to improve its presence and is in an advance stage of identifying a couple of projects and will subject to viability and board approval progress to next level of implementation.
The financial statements continue to be prepared on a going concern basis on the assumption that the company will commence its operations in near future.

risks: Company did not undertake any commercial activities during the year
There are no risks which in the opinion of the Board threaten the existence of the Company.
The appropriateness of assumption of going concern is dependent upon the company's ability to generate enough cash flow in future to meet its obligations.
100% of the share capital is eroded
The software used by the company during the year did not have the audit trail (edit log) facility for all relevant transactions
